players.bio: Abdallah Dipo Sima is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lens, and the Senegal national team.
Amadou Haidara (born 31 January 1998) is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Mali national team.
Andrija Bulatović (born 27 December 2006) is a Montenegrin professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for French Ligue 1 club Lens and the Montenegro national team.
Dino Nicolas Toppmöller (born 23 November 1980) is a German football manager and former player who is the manager of Ligue 1 side Lens.
Florian Sotoca (born 25 October 1990) is a French professional footballer who plays as a striker for Ligue 1 club Lens.

Florian Tristan Mariano Thauvin (born 26 January 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Ligue 1 club Lens and the France national team. He made his professional debut for Grenoble in 2011, moving on to Bastia where he won the Ligue 2 title in his first season and being named Young Player of the Year a year later.

Jean-Clair Dimitri Roger Todibo is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lens, on loan from West Ham United On 10 August 2024, Todibo signed for Premier League team, West Ham United on loan for the 2024–25 season. The deal includes an obligation to buy at the end of the season for €40 million.
Jhoanner Stalin Chávez Quintero (born 25 April 2002) is an Ecuadorian footballer who plays as left back for French club RC Lens and the Ecuador national team.

Jonathan Gradit (born 24 November 1992) is a French professional footballer who plays for RC Lens as a centre back. Career Gradit is a youth exponent from Tours. He made his Ligue 2 debut at 10 March 2014 against Angers SCO in a 2–0 home win.
Kyllian Anderson Antonio (born 4 January 2008) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Lens.

Maik Nawrocki (born 7 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lens. Born in Germany, he is a Polish youth international. Nawrocki is a homegrown product of SV Werder Bremen's youth system, joining the club at the age of 5.

Mathieu Gorgelin (born 5 August 1990) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. Gorgelin developed through the Lyon academy. He became a first team member in 2010. During the 2011/12 season, he was loaned out to Red Star. He made his debut in Ligue 1 on 2 November 2013 in a 2-0 home win against EA Guingamp.
Matthieu Marc Udol (born 20 March 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Lens.
Michał Krzysztof Skóraś (born 15 February 2000) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a winger or wing-back for Belgian Pro League club Gent and the Poland national team.
Michaël Bruno Dominique Cuisance (born 16 August 1999) is a French professional footballer . He has also represented France up to the under-20 level.

Nidal Čelik (pronounced ; born 17 July 2006) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lens and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Čelik started his professional career at Sarajevo, before joining Lens in 2025.

Odsonne Édouard (born 16 January 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace. Having progressed through the youth ranks of AF Bobigny, Édouard signed with Paris Saint-Germain in July 2011 before being loaned to fellow Ligue 1 side Toulouse for the 2016–17 season.
Pierre-Ismaëlo Ganiou (born 14 March 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lens. Born in France, he plays for the Burkina Faso national team.

Rayan Fofana (born 12 February 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lens. A youth product of Espérance Paris 19e and Lens, Fofana signed his first professional contract with Lens on 30 October 2024 until 2027. He made his senior and professional debut with the senior Lens squad in a 4–3 Ligue 1 loss to Le Havre on 1 March 2025.
Régis Gurtner (born 8 December 1986) is a French professional footballer who plays for Amiens SC as a goalkeeper. He previously played in Ligue 2 with Strasbourg, Boulogne and Le Havre.
Robin Risser Birckel (born 2 December 2004) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lens.
Ruben Aguilar (born 26 April 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lens.

Samson Baidoo (born 31 March 2004) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Lens and the Austria national team. International career Born in Austria, Baidoo is of Ghanaian descent; he has represented the former country at youth international level.

Saud Abdullah Salem Abdulhamid (born 18 July 1999) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lens, on loan from Serie A club Roma. He also plays for the Saudi Arabia national team. Abdulhamid previously played for Saudi Pro League clubs Al-Ittihad and Al-Hilal.

Thorgan Ganael Francis Hazard (born 29 March 1993) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder and winger for Belgian Pro League club Anderlecht and the Belgium national team. He began his professional career at Lens in Ligue 1, and moved to Chelsea in 2012 shortly after they had signed his older brother.

Yacine Mohamed El Ghazali Titraoui (Arabic: ياسين محمد الغزالي تيطراوي; born 26 August 2003) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Belgian club Charleroi and the Algeria national team.
